summary.text: Megan Srinivas is a Democratic state representative who has represented Iowa House District 30 since 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists Srinivas's profession as physician.

paragraphs.text: Megan Srinivas graduated from Fort Dodge Senior High School in 2005, according to Ballotpedia.
Srinivas earned a B.A. from Harvard University in 2009, an M.D. from the University of Iowa in 2014, and an M.P.H. from Harvard University in 2014.

Ballotpedia's account of the career includes work as a physician with the American Medical Association and as an infectious disease physician, clinical instructor and translational health policy researcher with the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill.
Srinivas was also a campus co-founder and co-coordinator with Peer Health Exchange.
Ballotpedia's campaign finance table lists a 2018 run for Iowa House District 9 that ended in a general-election loss.
Srinivas won the District 30 general election in 2022, defeating Jerry Cheevers (R), and won re-election over Cheevers in 2024.
In the 2025-2026 session Srinivas was assigned to the House Agriculture, Commerce, Judiciary and State Government committees.
